answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 27451 Country: India Title: 1 Can we wash our clothes in wash basin because we also wash our hands in wash basin after passing out stool and urine. qs 2:if we wash all clothes of family together in machine not properly but then clothes are dried in direct sunlight are these clothes paak? Question: a.o.a respected maulana sahib i have to ask that qs 1 :can we wash our clothes in wash basin because we also wash our hands in wash basin after passing out stool and urine. qs 2:if we wash all clothes of family together in machine not properly but then clothes are dried in direct sunlight are these clothes paak? Answer ID: 27451 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1653/152/M=1431) (1) If your conscience allows and washbasin is quite neat and clean, you can wash your clothes in it. (2) If your clothes were impure and they could not be washed properly in the washing machine, it is necessary to wash them again. It is not necessary to wash those clothes again that were paak (clean). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
